usedFor: Gtwy raises alerts when something fails, and Slack carries them to your team when “Error Alert” runs “Send Message”.

bestTemplate.name: “Error Alert” in Gtwy, then “Send Message” in Slack
bestTemplate.why: A failure in Gtwy reaches a Slack channel, so someone sees it without watching a dashboard.

watchOut: An automation's “Send Message” post to a Slack channel waits for approval today, which can delay an urgent error alert.
